slides.title: The solopreneur effect
slides.subtitle: Tiny firms spend like *big ones*.
slides.body: Firms under 50 people spend nearly as much per head as companies with 250+. Quinn's theory: solo founders and small teams are paying for serious AI, with few employees to divide it by.

slides.title: Plan for it
slides.subtitle: Budget AI like *cloud*, not like seats.
slides.body: Price per token keeps falling, but usage grows faster. Track AI spend per employee and per team, set usage alerts, and review it monthly like your cloud bill.
